sidecar_policy: authoring labels live in this sidecar so the frozen v22.4 blind benchmark bytes (and their SHA256) remain identical

class_definitions.literal_hand_written: Question text and values are explicitly written as individual benchmark rows in the source; no programmatic generation loop.
class_definitions.authored_template_generated: A human manually designed the semantic/surface template, but multiple instances were produced by loops with randomized values/entities (rng.randint / rng.sample / rng.choice).
class_definitions.synthetic_template_generated: Programmatically generated benchmark family based primarily on generalized templates.

faithfulness_verification.method: instrumented deterministic re-execution of build_v22_4_blind.build() (seeded rng), row-by-row comparison with the frozen JSONL
